lines: 第一章重生
叶欢重生了！
当叶秋躺在病床上仰望着天花板时，他终于清晰地意识到这个问题。
自己的确重生了，重生在这个地球的偏远星球上。
叶欢的灵魂的很强大，轻易融合了地球上“叶欢”这个脑海中的记忆。
说实话，窝囊废叶欢见多了，但像这具身体原主人这么窝囊废的，叶欢还是第一次见。
原本的“叶欢”好歹也是个大家族的的子弟，他老爹叶树仁更是叶家的领军人物，说起来这具身体的主人比一般的富二代牛逼多了。
可架不住这原本的“叶欢”花样作死，吃喝嫖赌，无恶不作，整个一个纨绔子弟。
关键是脑子还蠢，在上层社会是个人尽皆知的笑话。
这下可好，他老爹叶树仁对他失望的透顶，给他找了个媳妇儿就彻底不管他了，反正他也不止叶欢一个儿子。
“兄弟，你活得太窝囊，剩下的日子就让我替你翻身吧。”
叶欢悄悄地自语道，他虽然夺舍了这个人的身体，但内心没有丝毫的愧疚，因为叶欢本来不是什么好人。
叶欢嗜杀，在宇宙中纵横时，死在他手上的各族不计其数，被称为——杀神！
叶欢因为杀戮过多，体内形成了嗜血丹，修为大进，修为堪比不朽。
但也是这样，叶欢被嗜血丹影响了心智，疯狂杀戮，最终死于天劫！
不过最后还好嗜血丹救了他，在天劫之下硬生生包裹住他的灵魂，在地球上夺舍重生了。
叶欢闭上眼感受到体内的嗜血丹，那是一颗看上去普通的布满裂纹的暗红色珠子，此刻静静地悬浮在叶欢的脑海。
叶欢的叹了口气，对嗜血丹他是又爱又恨，是它让叶欢修炼神速，成为无敌杀神的。
可同样，也是嗜血丹让叶欢迷失心智，只知道杀戮，最终被天地绞杀！
当然，最后也是嗜血丹救了叶欢！
所以，叶欢现在对自己体内的嗜血丹是爱恨交织。
“醒了？醒了就换上衣服，跟我走！”一个冰冷的声音响起，没有丝毫的感情。
叶欢转头一看，一个漂亮的女人站在病房门口，即便是不施粉黛，也比电视上的女明星好看不少。
叶欢有这个女人的记忆，他的便宜媳妇儿——墨青语。
叶欢从原主人的记忆中知道两人的关系，自然知道以前的叶欢是怎样对待墨青语的，所以明白莫青语为什么会是这个态度。
墨青语嫁给叶欢的时候，叶欢已经——阳痿了！
可能是被酒色掏空了身体，也可能是被人下药了，但叶欢那时候的确阳痿了！
娶这么漂亮一个媳妇儿什么都不能做，叶欢对她的态度可想而知，所以也不怪墨青语会这样的冷淡。
至于墨青语为什么会嫁给叶欢的这种货色就很简单了，叶家有权有势，就这么简单。
叶欢也不多话，淡淡地看了墨青语一眼，就自己默默的换好衣服，跟在了墨青语的后面。
墨青语在路边拦了一辆出租车，两人在车上一句话没说，就回到了碧月山庄。
碧月山庄是青城市不错的别墅区，这里的别墅是他老爹叶树仁给他买的，给他这套别墅后，也就再也没有管过他。
进了别墅，叶欢看到院子里空空如也，只剩下一些破财的花草和一些无用的生活用品。
等墨青语开了门，叶欢走进门一看，才发现原来客厅里也是一副萧条，就一个普通的沙发，冰箱，和一个老式电视。
搜索了一下记忆，叶秋才知道这些东西已经被原来的叶欢卖了，为此不知道和墨青语吵过多少次。
叶欢心里顿时一阵无语，这兄弟也窝囊了，这么可怜的富二代真是少见。
墨青语完全没有搭理叶秋的意思，自顾自上了二楼，她的卧室在二楼。
叶欢的卧室在一楼，不是原来的叶欢愿意这样，只是原来的叶欢被酒色彻底掏空身体后，发现和墨青语打架竟然占不到任何便宜……
叶欢也是无奈，他感受了一些这具身体，真的是好弱，虚弱到甚至一不小心就会死亡，不然也不会被已经残破不堪的嗜血丹带着他的灵魂夺舍了。
不行，真的好弱，叶欢觉得自己累了！
虽然没走几步路，但叶欢觉得自己现在好累了，没办法，他只好回自己的房间睡觉。
“这副身体也太弱了，不行，我得赶紧修炼恢复身体了。”
这是叶欢躺在床上最后的一个想法，他太虚弱了，要睡觉，修炼什么的都等睡醒了再说吧。

Chapter 1 Rebirth
Ye Huan is reborn!
When Ye Qiu was lying on the hospital bed looking up at the ceiling, he finally realized this problem clearly.
I was indeed reborn, on a remote planet on this earth.
Ye Huan's soul is very powerful and easily merges with the memory of "Ye Huan" on earth.
To be honest, Ye Huan has seen a lot of cowards, but this is the first time that Ye Huan has seen such a coward like the original owner of this body.
The original "Ye Huan" was a child of a big family after all, and his father Ye Shuren was the leader of the Ye family. Speaking of which, the owner of this body was much more awesome than the average rich second generation.
But he couldn't stand the original "Ye Huan"'s ways of committing suicide, eating, drinking, prostitution and gambling, doing all kinds of evil, and he was like a playboy.
The key is that he is still stupid, which is a well-known joke in the upper class society.
This was good, his father Ye Shuren was so disappointed in him that he found him a wife and ignored him completely. Anyway, he was not just Ye Huan's son.
"Brother, you are living a useless life. Let me turn you around for the rest of your life."
Ye Huan whispered to himself that although he took this person's body, he didn't feel any guilt in his heart because Ye Huan was not a good person in the first place.
Ye Huan is bloodthirsty. When he roamed the universe, countless people from all races died at his hands. He was called the God of Killing!
Because Ye Huan killed too much, he formed a bloodthirsty pill in his body, and his cultivation level improved greatly, and his cultivation level was comparable to immortality.
But it was also the case that Ye Huan was mentally affected by the Bloodthirsty Pill, went on a killing spree, and eventually died from a natural disaster!
But in the end, fortunately, the Bloodthirsty Pill saved him, wrapped his soul in the catastrophe, and was reborn on the earth.
Ye Huan closed his eyes and felt the Bloodthirsty Pill in his body. It was an ordinary-looking dark red bead covered with cracks, floating quietly in Ye Huan's mind at this moment.
Ye Huan sighed. He loved and hated the Bloodthirsty Pill. It allowed Ye Huan to practice quickly and become an invincible killing god.
But it was also the bloodthirsty pill that made Ye Huan lose his mind and only knew how to kill, and was eventually strangled by heaven and earth!
Of course, it was the Bloodthirsty Pill that saved Ye Huan in the end!
Therefore, Ye Huan now has a mixture of love and hate for the bloodthirsty pill in his body.
"Are you awake? When you wake up, put on your clothes and follow me!" A cold voice sounded without any emotion.
Ye Huan turned around and saw a beautiful woman standing at the door of the ward. Even without makeup, she was much prettier than the female stars on TV.
Ye Huan has the memory of this woman, his cheap wife--Mo Qingyu.
Ye Huan knew the relationship between the two from the memory of the original owner, and naturally knew how Ye Huan treated Mo Qingyu in the past, so he understood why Mo Qingyu had this attitude.
When Mo Qingyu married Ye Huan, Ye Huan was already impotent!
It might be that his body was drained by alcohol and sex, or it might be that he was drugged, but Ye Huan was indeed impotent at that time!
You can't do anything with such a beautiful wife. Ye Huan's attitude towards her can be imagined, so it's no wonder that Mo Qingyu is so cold.
As for why Mo Qingyu married Ye Huan, it was very simple. The Ye family was powerful, it was that simple.
Ye Huan didn't say much. He glanced at Mo Qingyu indifferently, then silently changed his clothes and followed Mo Qingyu.
Mo Qingyu hailed a taxi on the side of the road, and the two of them returned to Biyue Villa without saying a word in the car.
Biyue Villa is a good villa area in Qingcheng City. The villa here was bought for him by his father Ye Shuren. After giving him this villa, he never took care of him again.
After entering the villa, Ye Huan saw that the yard was empty, with only some ruined flowers and plants and some useless daily necessities left.
When Mo Qingyu opened the door, Ye Huan walked in and found that the living room was also in a bleak state, with just an ordinary sofa, refrigerator, and an old-fashioned TV.
After searching his memory, Ye Qiu found out that these things had been sold by the original Ye Huan, and he had quarreled with Mo Qingyu many times over this.
Ye Huan was speechless for a while. This brother was also a coward. Such pitiful rich second generation was really rare.
Mo Qingyu paid no attention to Ye Qiu and went up to the second floor. Her bedroom was on the second floor.
Ye Huan's bedroom is on the first floor. It's not that the original Ye Huan wanted to be like this. It's just that after the original Ye Huan was completely drained by wine and sex, he found that he couldn't gain any advantage in fighting with Mo Qingyu...
Ye Huan was also helpless. He felt that this body was really weak, so weak that he would die if he was not careful, otherwise he would not have been taken away by the already broken Bloodthirsty Pill and his soul.
No, it’s really weak. Ye Huan feels tired!
Although he hadn't walked a few steps, Ye Huan felt that he was very tired now. He had no choice but to go back to his room to sleep.
"This body is too weak. It won't work. I have to practice quickly to recover."
This was Ye Huan's last thought while lying on the bed. He was too weak. If he wanted to sleep, he should wait until he woke up to practice and other things.
